verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents issue triage states: the MCP update_issue tool can resolve, unresolve, or ignore an issue, and the product is positioned as a place to triage and resolve errors. Team-based notification is not owner assignment, and nothing in the evidence shows regressions reopening resolved issues. missing for 10: assigning an issue owner, snooze/time-boxed ignore, automatic reopen of resolved issues on regression, first-party UI triage docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
